warning: DRAFT FIELD SOURCE MATRIX ONLY. NOT PRODUCTION CONTRACT. NOT SAMPLE INGEST. NOT ML TRAINING DATA.

active_mainline.notes: Current mainline is QINIST_001 Sanman starter collection, not Baiya second-piece expansion.

qid.notes: Rejected placeholder; use qinist_id, qin_id, or explicit IDs.

qinist_id.notes: QINIST_001 is Sanman; QINIST_002 Baiya is comparison/reference only.

qinist_name.notes: Display/support field; qinist_id remains the stable key.

piece_id.notes: Current V1 score CSV uses piece_id; formal Dapu schema uses work_id.

work_id.notes: Formal Dapu IR work key. Starter intake may map piece_id to work_id explicitly.

piece_title.notes: Display metadata; not a stable key.

source_score_id.notes: Needed to tie parsed events to score authority; not currently a first-class repo column.

event_id.notes: Repo canonical event identity; external docs may call the same concept score_event_id.

score_event_id.notes: Use as semantic sidecar label only when explicitly mapped to repo event_id.

gesture_event_id.notes: Documented ML-ready sidecar concept; repo lacks a frozen concrete field.

event_range.notes: Can be empty for atomic events; required for many RECD/VARW review contracts.

source_token.notes: Formal Dapu input token; current score_events.csv equivalent is raw_input.

raw_input.notes: Legacy V1 score-event field; map to source_token for Dapu IR.

normalized_name.notes: Human-facing prompt/recording label; not score authority by itself.

primary_sound_type.notes: Allowed values in Dapu IR are only 散音, 按音, 泛音.

sound_type.notes: Existing P1-F dry-run field; starter design should normalize it to primary_sound_type before freezing any future schema.

sound_profile.notes: Needed for complex techniques and pressed-sound structure validation.

gesture_family.notes: Use existing families such as single_pluck, pressed_pluck, harmonic_pluck, left_hand_sound, post_motion.

gesture_id.notes: Canonical V1 gesture identifier; do not collapse complex techniques into opaque gesture-only labels.

gesture_id_candidate.notes: Candidate key for parser output before canon/human confirmation.

technique.notes: Useful human-facing extraction term; should be backed by components/gesture_id.

special_technique.notes: Keeps special techniques out of primary_sound_type.

components.notes: Required for pressed-sound and complex technique validation.

component_name.notes: Use standard internal names; aliases like 劈/pi and 拨 are not canonical internal names.

component_category.notes: Important for pre/post action and motion validation.

component_role.notes: Used to distinguish attack, pre_action, post_motion, etc.

component_sound_type.notes: Allowed values are 散音, 按音, 泛音, none.

string_no.notes: Component-level string number. External docs often say string.

string.notes: Existing dry-run and documented sidecar field; map to component string_no where Dapu schema is authoritative.

hui.notes: Component-level hui. Pressed sound may need source and target hui.

hui_position.notes: Existing dry-run and documented sidecar field; map to hui/hui_target for structure validation.

hui_target.notes: Needed for pressed motion and position shift validation.

motion_returns.notes: Important for 进复/退复 and returning motion validation.

notation_pre_action.notes: Explicit score-marked chuo/zhu only; Sanman default chuo belongs to realization, not score facts.

notation_vibrato.notes: Explicit score-marked yin/nao only; defaults belong to realization.

context_dependency.notes: Key for context-take requirements and inheritance review.

needs_context_take.notes: Dry-run coverage field; must not make context takes atomic samples.

needs_long_tail.notes: Dry-run field; maps to full_tail/natural_decay policy.

needs_retake.notes: Review/control status; not a sample asset state.

source_status.notes: Formal parser source status; OCR candidates require needs_review=true.

parse_status.notes: V1 score-event status equivalent; map carefully.

source_confidence.notes: Dry-run confidence field; formal Dapu schema uses certainty.

session_id.notes: Used by generic scripts/manifests; map to recording_session_id for RECD/VARW CSVs.

recording_id.notes: Stable recording identity; not equivalent to take_id.

recording_take_no.notes: Stable whole-session take number; take_id cannot replace it.

batch_id.notes: Batch identity; Baiya T071 belongs to batch08 in existing baseline, but Sanman kit must not reuse Baiya batch facts as Sanman data.

script_id.notes: Plan/script identity for linking prompts/takes to review rows.

source_take_id.notes: Candidate-sidecar provenance concept; implementation must bind it to recording_take_no/source paths without replacing them.

take_id.notes: Display/compatibility alias only; cannot replace recording_take_no.

source_raw_audio.notes: Canonical raw audio provenance for R0; keep distinct from source_split_audio.

source_split_audio.notes: Canonical split audio path for R1; not interchangeable with raw source.

source_audio.notes: Stage-specific compatibility alias only; must not become canonical.

segment_id.notes: R1 split segment identity; existing recording_segments.csv is not to be written in this task.

audio_segment_ref.notes: Sidecar reference only; not a sample ingest row.

realization_variant.notes: Qinist realization field, not score fact.

variant.notes: Compatibility alias only; cannot replace realization_variant.

tail_policy.notes: Guqin default is full_tail/natural_decay; smart_fade_100ms requires explicit override.

anchor_type.notes: Compatibility alias only; cannot replace render_anchor_type.

marker_type.notes: R0/R1/R2 marker families differ; do not merge enums blindly.

review_status.notes: Internal enum values only; Chinese labels belong only in *_label_zh fields.

segment_status.notes: R1 enum: candidate, render_usable, reference_only, unclear, needs_retake, rejected, excluded.

human_accepted.notes: Does not mean sample asset creation.

reviewed_at.notes: Must not be faked from updated_at.

updated_at.notes: Export/update timestamp; not a substitute for reviewed_at.

wrong_take.notes: Wrong takes must be excluded from candidate pool.

is_wrong_take.notes: Sidecar boolean wrapper around review exclusion semantics.

is_failed_take.notes: Must exclude failed takes; repo has needs_retake/rejected but no frozen failed-take sidecar field.

is_context_only.notes: Prevents context candidates from becoming atomic samples.

exclusion_reason.notes: Needed to keep wrong/failed/context-only exclusions auditable; existing reject_reason is R1 QC-specific. Requires user approval before implementation.

candidate_id.notes: Needed as stable sidecar row identity; existing sample_id is sample ingest, so it is insufficient. Requires user approval before implementation.

candidate_status.notes: Documented values include candidate, hold, reject.

required_review_missing.notes: Blocks ML-ready interpretation when labels are incomplete.

not_sample_assets.notes: Safety flag; must remain true in this design.

not_recording_segments.notes: Safety flag; this task must not write recording_segments.csv.

not_recording_items_enriched.notes: Needed in mock/draft artifacts because the hard red line explicitly forbids recording_items_enriched.jsonl. Requires user approval before production use.

not_ml_training_data.notes: Safety flag; ML-ready sidecar design is not ML training data.

review_only.notes: Must remain true for these artifacts.

production_grade.notes: Must remain false for these artifacts.

preferred_version_id.notes: Existing VARW preference summary field; use for profile mapping rather than inventing disconnected labels.

preferredVersionByPhrase.notes: Canonical latest JSON map for phrase preference.

listeningReviewByKey.notes: Canonical latest JSON review map. Backend single-colon keys may require frontend double-colon normalization, but mapping should not rewrite authority.

issue_type.notes: Existing R2 issue taxonomy; do not create disconnected R2 label system.

profile_signal_id.notes: Needed to identify a derived Qinist Profile signal without creating a new R2 label system. Requires user approval before implementation.

profile_signal_type.notes: Needed to group timing/tail/ornament/cadence/rejection-pattern signals. Requires user approval before implementation.

confidence.notes: Existing confidence-like field; profile use must cite evidence.

evidence_refs.notes: Needed for profile/sidecar traceability across VARW latest JSON and derived exports. Requires user approval before implementation.

starter_item_id.notes: Needed to identify kit items independent of real take IDs. Existing script_id is plan-specific and insufficient. Requires user approval before implementation.

kit_id.notes: Needed to keep the universal kit separate from Sanman instance. Requires user approval before implementation.

priority_tier.notes: Needed for P0/P1/P2/P3/SKIP design priority. Requires user approval before implementation.

coverage_status.notes: Needed for coverage diff outputs such as already_covered/missing/must_record_atomic. Requires user approval before implementation.

prompt_manifest_id.notes: Needed to identify a collection prompt manifest. Requires user approval before implementation.

prompt_id.notes: Needed to identify one prompted collection item before recording. Requires user approval before implementation.

prompt_text_zh.notes: Needed for concise qinist-facing prompt; existing human_instruction is longer recording-script prose. Requires user approval before implementation.

trigger_text.notes: Needed to model 发令枪 text such as 开始. Requires user approval before implementation.

prompt_interval_s.notes: Needed for prompt cadence; existing recommended_pause_s is post-take silence in old recording script, not the same as next prompt interval. Requires user approval before implementation.

prompt_order.notes: Needed to order prompt playback without claiming a real take was recorded. Requires user approval before implementation.

retake_policy.notes: Needed to keep bad/retake behavior auditable before R0. Requires user approval before implementation.

bad_take_policy.notes: Needed to keep bad takes from becoming candidates. Requires user approval before implementation.

sample_id.notes: Existing sample ingest field; unsafe for this design because task forbids writing sample_assets.csv.

sample_asset_created.notes: Rejected because human acceptance or sidecar candidate must not imply sample asset creation.

recording_segments_write.notes: Rejected because this task must not write recording_segments.csv.

recording_items_enriched_jsonl.notes: Rejected because this task must not write recording_items_enriched.jsonl.

baiya_as_sanman_style.notes: Rejected: Baiya is workflow baseline/comparison only, not Sanman style data.

multi_piece_parser_input.notes: Rejected: guqin-dapu-parser must remain single-piece; aggregation belongs to workflow/diff layer.
